crime: Whenever choices left {WITCH_NAME} unable to act, she asked her closest companion to decide for her. The companion liked being needed and gradually took charge of everything they did together. They always held private conversations on the left-hand sofa in the lounge.

One morning during free time, the companion offered {WITCH_NAME} a choice between the projector and pool. {WITCH_NAME} reached for the projector remote. The companion took it away, put a pool cue in her hands, and decided that they would play pool instead. When {WITCH_NAME} protested, the companion told her that she did not know what she wanted and demanded an apology after lunch.

After the meal, the companion sent a prison chat message saying that she was waiting at their usual place, then sat on the left-hand sofa. {WITCH_NAME} remained in the entrance hall talking with several girls. They saw the companion enter the lounge alone and kept the doorway in sight. No one crossed it before the crossbow fired.

The group rushed inside. The companion was dead on the sofa, pierced by the bolt. The lounge crossbow lay wedged level along the back of the opposite sofa, aimed at the body. No line or weight was attached to its bare trigger. A strip torn from {WITCH_NAME}'s distinctive sleeve was pinched beneath the stock where the sofa supported it, with its other edge caught on a splinter. Its color, weave, and torn edge matched a fresh rip in the same sleeve.

The victim's message and their usual meeting place showed that {WITCH_NAME} knew which sofa would be occupied. The trapped cloth proved that she had positioned the crossbow. The watched doorway ruled out anyone entering to fire it, while the bare trigger ruled out a delayed pull.

Before the meeting, {WITCH_NAME} had wedged and aimed the unloaded crossbow, personally completed one full pull of its trigger, and then loaded it. From the entrance hall, she used Action Replay on that earlier trigger pull. An unseen force immediately repeated the pull once on the same crossbow, firing the bolt that killed her companion.
fields.epitaph: At last, even the first word of blame was no longer hers.
execution: A massive iron judgment seal hangs above her face, with her head fixed against a rigid rest.

She draws breath to confess before judgment can be passed on her. The seal strikes her mouth before she can finish, then falls again and again, crushing her mouth and jaw against the rest. The seal stays down and keeps pressing until her skull breaks and she dies.

magic.name: Action Replay
magic.text: She can make an object repeat a physical action she previously performed on it.
